atrium_studio_default_title: We design quiet things that endure.
atrium_studio_s1_desc: Marks, typography systems, art direction. Quiet, considered, built to last past the launch.
atrium_studio_s2_desc: Books, catalogues, long-form web. The kind of reading that asks for a second cup of coffee.
atrium_studio_s3_desc: Sites that load fast, age well, and do not need a designer to update. Built on flat files.
atrium_studio_final_title: Have a project that needs unhurried thinking?
atrium_exh_ev1_desc: Official opening with a welcome address, artist presentations, and a guided walkthrough of the main galleries.
atrium_exh_ev2_desc: Four photographers and one philosopher discuss deliberation, analogue process, and the ethics of looking.
atrium_exh_ev3_desc: Evening opening with live string quartet, candle-lit installations, and a limited-edition print available on the night.
atrium_exh_ev4_desc: A hands-on darkroom session for twelve participants. Booking required. Materials and chemicals provided.
atrium_exh_ev5_desc: Final afternoon open to registered collectors, followed by a closing toast with the artists.
atrium_exh_practical_desc: Open Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 – 19:00. Late night Thursdays until 22:00. Free admission. Guided tours every Saturday at 11:00 and 15:00.
